title: The Sticker Mission
rule: If Vishu decorates it, Didi gets final approval!
hook: Tomorrow, Vishu spots a tower of plastic cups...
caption: Vishu found Didi's sticker sheet — and suddenly everything looked like it needed stars! ⭐😂

panels.speaker: Pihu
panels.text: Now YOU get one tiny star!

title: The Cup Tower
rule: Tiny builders must help rebuild what they crash!
hook: Next, Vishu discovers the tissue box...
caption: A few plastic cups became Vishu's biggest construction project — until Didi walked in. 🥤🏗️😂

panels.speaker: Pihu
panels.text: Now the engineer cleans the site!

title: Tissue Snowstorm
rule: If you make indoor snow, you help collect every snowflake!
hook: Tomorrow's clue: colourful toy blocks on the floor...
caption: Vishu discovered that tissues can become snow. Didi discovered that snow can cover an entire room. ❄️😂

panels.speaker: Pihu
panels.text: Vishu... that is the tissue box.

title: The Block Roadblock
rule: Mischief roads need a clean-up lane too!
hook: Next episode: Vishu hears two spoons making music...
caption: Vishu built a roadblock right where Didi needed to walk. The traffic police arrived quickly. 🚧😂

panels.speaker: Pihu
panels.text: That is a very expensive toll.

panels.speaker: Pihu
panels.text: Now toll officer clears every block.

title: The Spoon Orchestra
rule: Every noisy concert needs a quiet finale!
hook: Tomorrow, the laundry basket starts moving...
caption: Vishu found two spoons. The living room immediately became a concert hall. 🥄🎵😂

panels.speaker: Pihu
panels.text: Only if the drummer plays softly.

title: The Laundry Train
rule: Passengers ride only after the laundry reaches its station!
hook: Next, Vishu finds Didi's stack of storybooks...
caption: A laundry basket plus one mischievous toddler equals the Vishu Express. 🚂😂

panels.speaker: Pihu
panels.text: Cupboard first, then one tiny ride.

title: The Book Stack
rule: Book towers are for reading before rebuilding!
hook: Tomorrow: fridge magnets mysteriously change places...
caption: Vishu turned Didi's books into a tower. Didi turned the tower into story time. 📚😂

title: The Magnet Mix-Up
rule: If you rearrange the letters, you help put the message back!
hook: Next: Vishu discovers a basket of soft toys...
caption: The fridge alphabet had one job. Vishu gave it a completely new language. 🔤😂

panels.speaker: Pihu
panels.text: Professor Vishu, class now fixes ABC.
